name: Ring of Djinni Summoning

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon the Djinni
powers.text: Magic action: a djinni appears within 120 ft, friendly and obeying you, for up to 1 hour (Concentration); once a day.

summary: Once a day, summon a djinni that serves you for up to an hour.
text: While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to summon a particular Djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of you. It remains as long as you maintain Concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 Hit Points. While summoned, the djinni is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions. After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.
